note: Indian Kanoon reports 338 documents matching 'Alfa Laval India'; the 8 above are the top-relevance hits reviewed. All are ordinary tax/excise/arbitration/commercial matters spanning 1999-2017, with the company appearing as both petitioner and respondent; none is a criminal matter, insolvency (NCLT/IBC) proceeding or regulatory penalty. Per project rule 2 these are not rejection grounds and are recorded neutrally. IMPORTANT LIMITATIONS: the OFAC SDN search tool (sanctionssearch.ofac.treas.gov) is a JavaScript application and returned no query results via plain HTTP; the OFAC JSON API endpoint returned HTTP 404; DuckDuckGo/searx backend was unreachable ('Connection refused' / timeout); Bing returned identical irrelevant results for every query, so no usable web search was possible. Therefore sanctions exposure (OFAC SDN, UN, EU, UK, BIS Entity List), credit rating, negative news and any evidence of supplies to Russia/CIS could NOT be verified and are recorded as null rather than asserted as absent. No public evidence of Russia/CIS supply by the Indian entity was found in the sources actually reachable, but this is an absence of verification, not a verified absence. Recommend re-running sanctions screening (OFAC/EU/UK/BIS consolidated list) and a credit-rating check (CRISIL/ICRA/India Ratings) once search access is restored. Note also that the input name list mixes several variants including 'ALPHA LEVEL INDIA LTD.', which is a different spelling and should be confirmed against the actual counterparty; the PAN AAACA5899A appears in the ITAT Pune 2017 order text for Alfa Laval India Ltd. and is cited here only as it appears in that judgment, not as a verified registry record.
